text:
sam: Heads-up: onboarding call with Ascend Health in 2pm PT. They sent an SQ with BYOK + SIEM + retention asks. Quick sync?

maria: Thanks. Which questions are blocking the packet? Can you paste the SQ excerpt?

sam: TL;DR: 1) RBAC scoping for tenant admins vs support engineers 2) Audit log retention 13 months, immutable export to customer's Splunk 3) BYOK: customer wants envelope encryption + HSM-backed key 4) Vulnerability triage SLAs - they ask 'critical within 24h' 5) Incident response: forensic access and access logs

jon: Ascend is healthcare, they'll ask for HIPAA mapping too. They want contractual SLA for log retention. :grimacing:

maria: High-level answers we can give now: RBAC - we support hierarchical roles via service accounts + role mappings; we can emit role-change events to audit stream. For tenants we have 'tenant-admin', 'org-readonly', 'support-ops' roles. We can provide exported IAM mappings as evidence.

kevin: For logs: we can ship structured audit events to a customer-owned Splunk HEC or S3 bucket. Retention is configurable on customer's side; for hosted we keep 13 months on our long-term archive for enterprise plans. Export example: 

```
# create Splunk HEC sink
redwoodctl logging create-sink --dest splunk --url https://splunk-acme.example --token xxxx --format json
```

kevin: We also support signed, append-only log exports (S3 + SHA256 chain) if they require immutable proof.

maria: KMS/BYOK: we support envelope encryption with customer KMS (GCP KMS, AWS KMS, or on-prem HSM via KMIP). For HSM-backed BYOK, we require an evidence handshake and an SLA for key availability. We also support rotating customer keys and can produce paper trail for key use.

sam: Do we need a legal addendum for BYOK/HSM? They asked about key custody guarantees.

maria: Yes — BYOK with custody options typically needs an addendum. For HSM we require key escrow options clarified. I'll loop in legal. @jon please flag procurement.

jon: flagged. I'll start the procurement thread and add the compliance checklist.

sam: Vulnerability triage SLA: can we commit to 24h for critical? Ops currently follows triage pager oncall and target is 24h initial response, patch timeline depends on severity. Suggest wording: 'Redwood acknowledges critical vulnerabilities and provides initial triage within 24 hours; remediation timelines depend on exploitability and availability of upstream fixes.' Thoughts?

maria: Agree. Don't promise fixed patch window unless engineering confirms. We'll offer collaborative triage and evidence sharing.

kevin: For forensic access: we can provide time-limited support bundles (logs, JVMS, core dumps) under NDA and logged access. Access to customer-owned environments (Dedicated/Private) is controlled by SCIM/service accounts, and any access is recorded.

sec-bot: Docs: https://redwood.example/docs/security/byok https://redwood.example/docs/audit/log-export https://redwood.example/docs/incident-response

sam: Great. Action items:
- maria: produce SQ answers + sample evidence links (due EOD)
- kevin: prepare Splunk HEC example + S3 immutability notes (due EOD)
- jon: start procurement + legal addendum thread (due tom)

maria: Will do. Also recommend asking Ascend if they want log exports pushed or if they'll pull from S3; that affects signing and retention.

sam: pinging @kevin — do we have sample signed export template we can send now?

kevin: attaching template in this thread (s3-export-manifest.json) — small sample below:

```
{"manifest_version":"1","objects":[{"path":"audits/2025-03-01.json.gz","sha256":"ab12..."}],"signed_by":"redwood-logsigner-v1"}
```

kevin: Note: to enable HSM BYOK for envelope keys we need two business days for provisioning + legal.

sam: ack. I'll prep the packet and run the call. Thanks team :thumbsup:

jon: If they want a white-glove onboarding add checklist: include penetration test evidence + SOC2 summary.

maria: I'll include SOC2 excerpts and a redaction-safe penetration summary.

sam: Closing — we'll present on the call and deliver docs pack after. Thanks.
